instrument.garageband: create a Software Instrument track, open Smart Controls (B) > Plug-ins > Instrument slot > AU Instruments > Windward Audio > @NAME@
instrument.logic: Instrument slot of a Software Instrument track > AU Instruments > Windward Audio > @NAME@
instrument.other: in the instrument list, as AU or VST3

effect.garageband: on any track, open Smart Controls (B) > Plug-ins > an empty slot > Audio Units > Windward Audio > @NAME@
effect.logic: any Audio FX slot > Audio Units > Windward Audio > @NAME@
effect.other: in the effect list, as AU or VST3
